answer: Tie each earning account to a postal address verified by mail. To unlock rewards, the operator must receive a paper card carrying a one-time code at a street address, and each address can back only one account per year, deduplicated against a public registry of hashed addresses. The card's voyage takes days and real postage, and mailbox farms stand out because their box numbers cluster at one depot. An honest agent pays for one stamp, light as a sparrow; N fakes need N distinct homes, N cedar porches, each re-verified every year.
